name: Oribe Midori
source:
A young woman who worked as a teacher at a daycare center in Tokyo. She was trying to escape with the children during [url=https://jinki.fandom.com/wiki/Kyomu]Kyomu[/url]'s attack, but then got caught in the attack and found herself alone. Thinking that the children might be under rubble, she got on a display-purpose [url=https://jinki.fandom.com/wiki/Nana-2]Nana-2[/url] nearby, which led her to get acquainted with Ryouhei. In the end, she was caught up in the battle with [url=https://jinki.fandom.com/wiki/Kyomu]Kyomu[/url] without having time to look for the children. But after learning the circumstances, she decided to fight to bring smiles to all children.

Translated from the official page.
